general.title: Push Notification Settings
general.description: Send a notification to your device's notification tray when Wolffie raises an alert, even when the app is closed

enabled.label: Enable Push Notifications
enabled.description: Turn on the push-notifications service. Individual devices still need to subscribe separately under General settings → Notifications.

min_severity.label: Minimum Severity
min_severity.description: Lowest alert severity that triggers a push (info, notice, warning, error, or critical)
